LESSON: DANGEROUS CHEMICALS AT HOME

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Safety Education
Topic 4.4: Dangerous chemicals at home

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Dangerous chemicals at home
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Dangerous chemicals at home
2. give Kenyan examples of Dangerous chemicals at home
3. practise a safe skill for Dangerous chemicals at home

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Dangerous chemicals at home

Teach
• Observe Dangerous chemicals at home in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Dangerous chemicals at home (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Dangerous chemicals at home.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Dangerous chemicals at home.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Dangerous chemicals at home.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Dangerous chemicals at home.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Dangerous chemicals at home: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Dangerous chemicals at home with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
